RAG architecture.label: Conceptual architecture. Not a claim of implemented or tested components.
RAG architecture.diagram:
flowchart LR
A[Documents]-->B[Chunking]-->C[Embeddings]-->D[(Vector DB)]
U[User query]-->E[Retriever]
D-->E-->F[Prompt builder]-->G[LLM]-->H[Answer + sources]
RAG architecture.components: Ingestion, chunker, embedder, vector store, retriever, prompt builder, LLM, evaluator.
RAG architecture.data_flow: Documents are chunked and embedded offline; queries retrieve top-k chunks that ground the LLM prompt.
RAG architecture.responsibilities: Ingestion prepares data; retriever selects context; LLM generates grounded answers.
RAG architecture.technology: Python, LangChain, vector database, Amazon Bedrock, FastAPI.
RAG architecture.integration: Document sources, LLM API, application API.
RAG architecture.security: Access control on documents, PII handling, secrets in a manager.
RAG architecture.scalability: Scale ingestion in batches; scale vector store independently.
RAG architecture.failure: Fallback to 'no answer' when retrieval is weak; retries on LLM errors.
RAG architecture.monitoring: Latency, retrieval hit-rate, groundedness scores, cost.

Agentic AI architecture.label: Conceptual architecture. Not a claim of implemented or tested components.
Agentic AI architecture.diagram:
flowchart TD
U[User]-->P[Planner]-->R{Router}
R-->T1[Tool: API]
R-->T2[Tool: Retriever]
T1-->M[(Memory)]
T2-->M
M-->P
P-->H[Human approval]-->O[Output]
Agentic AI architecture.components: Planner, router, tools, memory, human approval gate.
Agentic AI architecture.data_flow: Planner decomposes a task, calls tools, stores state in memory, and requests approval for sensitive actions.
Agentic AI architecture.responsibilities: Planner decides; tools act; memory keeps state; human gate controls risk.
Agentic AI architecture.technology: LangGraph, LangChain, Amazon Bedrock, MCP, FastAPI.
Agentic AI architecture.security: Least-privilege tool permissions; approval for write actions.
Agentic AI architecture.scalability: Stateless workers with external state store.
Agentic AI architecture.failure: Step limits, retries, and graceful tool-failure handling.
Agentic AI architecture.monitoring: Trace every step; evaluate task success rate.
